reuse.reason: The pinned official statistics plugins describe model/session execution and telemetry, not deployment-wide SaaS account, merchant-order or transactional-email aggregates. Mounting or forking them would require replacing product behavior rather than adapting Host data. This independent read-only plugin composes local authentication, the established site-administrator policy and payment service with real D1 aggregate queries.
gaps: Counts are current local database projections, not provider settlement reports or revenue. Missing tables, unavailable optional services and failed queries are represented explicitly. No personal emails, money aggregation, sample charts or outbound analytics are returned.
